title: setDesiredAPY commit is mempool-visible: stakers front-run the commit to lock in a higher (or lower) accPhUSDPerShare than the protocol intends

knownIssueCheck.candidate: KI-1 'Two-step APY setting process (intentional security feature)'
knownIssueCheck.rationale: KI-1 advertises the gate as a security feature. This finding shows the gate provides no MEV protection because the committed value equals the public pendingAPYBps. The bug is in the design assumption of the gate, not its existence. Distinct economic surface.
